Rationale.RP1_ImplementationReconstructability: The experiment can be reconstructed from the plan and CodeWalkthrough documentation. The plan clearly describes the hypothesis, methodology (ECS via attention scores, PKS via FFN JS-divergence), classifier training pipeline, and evaluation metrics. The codebase provides clear implementations in compute_scores.py, classifier.py, and predict.py. Pre-computed scores in datasets/ directory allowed exact replication without re-running computationally intensive score extraction.
Rationale.RP2_EnvironmentReproducibility: The environment can be set up with standard Python packages (scikit-learn, xgboost, pandas, numpy, scipy, matplotlib, seaborn). Minor version warnings occurred when loading pre-trained models (scikit-learn 1.7.1 vs 1.8.0) but did not affect functionality. All code executed successfully. The repository includes requirements.txt files and pre-computed datasets eliminate need for TransformerLens model loading.
Rationale.RP3_DeterminismAndStability: Replicated results are stable and consistent with reported values. Key findings reproduced: ECS correlation -0.2908 (negative as expected), PKS correlation +0.2806 (positive as expected), SVC validation F1 76.01% (reported 76.60%), self-eval response F1 73.42% (reported 74.68%), proxy-eval response F1 76.78% (reported 75.36%). Differences <2 percentage points are within expected variance from random seeds and version differences. Qualitative findings fully match.
Rationale.RP4_DemoPresentation: The repository does not contain a separate demo. It provides a full research implementation with pre-computed datasets, pre-trained models, and command-line scripts for each pipeline stage. This criterion is not applicable to this type of repository.
